articles.text: 教師(ウェイトレス): 何にいたしましょうか。(メニューを渡す) (Kyoushi (Ueetoresu): Nan ni itashimashoo ka? (handing student the menu))
INSTRUCTOR (WAITRESS): What would you like? (handing the student the menu)
学生: ちょっと待ってください。(メニューを見る) (Gakusei: Chotto matte kudasai. (looking at the menu))
STUDENT: Please wait a moment. (looking at the menu)
学生 (1 - tori, doesn't like hot): とりはどこですか。これは辛くありませんか。 (Gakusei (1): Tori wa doko desu ka? Kore wa karaku arimasen ka?)
STUDENT (1 - chicken, doesn't like hot/spicy): Where is the chicken? This one isn't spicy, is it?
学生 (2 - sakana, doesn't like spicy): 魚はどこですか。これは辛くありませんか。 (Gakusei (2): Sakana wa doko desu ka? Kore wa karaku arimasen ka?)
STUDENT (2 - fish, doesn't like spicy): Where is the fish? This one isn't spicy, is it?
学生 (3 - yasai, doesn't like sweet): 野菜はどこですか。これは甘くありませんか。 (Gakusei (3): Yasai wa doko desu ka? Kore wa amaku arimasen ka?)
STUDENT (3 - vegetables, doesn't like sweet): Where are the vegetables? This one isn't sweet, is it?
学生 (4 - pooku, doesn't like sour): ポークはどこですか。これは酸っぱくありませんか。 (Gakusei (4): Pooku wa doko desu ka? Kore wa suppaku arimasen ka?)
STUDENT (4 - pork, doesn't like sour): Where is the pork? This one isn't sour, is it?
学生 (5 - biifu, doesn't like salty): ビーフはどこですか。これは塩辛くありませんか。 (Gakusei (5): Biifu wa doko desu ka? Kore wa shiokaraku arimasen ka?)
STUDENT (5 - beef, doesn't like salty): Where is the beef? This one isn't salty, is it?
教師: (味について答える) (Kyoushi: (answers about the taste))
INSTRUCTOR: (answers about the taste — if it is not the taste you dislike, order it; if it is, choose a different dish.)
学生: じゃ、これ、お願いします。 (Gakusei: Jaa, kore onegai shimasu.)
STUDENT: I'll have this one, then, please.
